|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Grogu]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the current Players Committee card image (published 30 December 2024, marked E1). This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[Grogu]]): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a519d514de0c15525458580c14f6b792a14c46a swccg-card-json commit 1a519d514d] (4 September 2021): dating evidence only.</ref>: “While defending a battle, Interrupts may not be played unless they are [Immune to Sense]. Opponent may not target Grogu with weapons unless each of your Mandalorians and non-[Episode I] Jedi present are 'hit.' Immune to attrition &lt; 3.” No E mark. Deploy 4, forfeit 6. Margin: “Away Put Your Weapon”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Grogu (Errata)]]): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While defending a battle, Interrupts may not be played unless they are [Immune to Sense]. Opponent may not target Grogu with weapons unless each of your Mandalorians and non-[Episode I] Jedi present are 'hit.' Immune to attrition &lt; 3.” Same game text words as the original; no E mark. The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E1 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/grogu.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4da5a9ec5636a391e4113eba01c7463a1b42ba32 swccg-card-json commit 4da5a9ec56] (13 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>: “May deploy Foundling on Grogu from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or Lost Pile. Once per game, if present during battle, may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt or place your just lost Mandalorian in Used Pile. Immune to attrition &lt; 3.” Deploy 3, forfeit 4. The image prints “May ▼ (or deploy from Lost Pile) Foundling on Grogu”; the card list writes the arrow out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck (reshuffle)”). The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the original text. The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. The printed mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The whole game text was replaced: the battle-defense Interrupt lock and the weapon-targeting protection were removed; Grogu now may deploy Foundling on himself from Reserve Deck or Lost Pile and, once per game while present in battle, may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt or save a just-lost Mandalorian to Used Pile. “Immune to attrition &lt; 3” kept. Deploy changed from 4 to 3 and forfeit from 6 to 4. The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
